summary_en: 3,566,984 shares to be cancelled. Effective 2026-08-26. Post-cancellation issued shares: 12,714,389.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, Sanshin Electronics' board of directors resolved to cancel 3,566,984 treasury shares pursuant to Company Law Article 178. The cancellation is scheduled for 26 August 2026 (Wednesday). These shares represent 21.9% of the issued share count prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company's issued shares outstanding will total 12,714,389.
